headline.zh: 制皂厂旧址改造的工业风咖啡院
headline.en: Industrial coffee yard in former Shanghai Soap Factory

traits.zh: 由上海制皂厂老厂房改造，保留齿轮、钢架、水泥墙面
traits.en: Converted from Shanghai Soap Factory's old factory, retaining gears, steel frames, and concrete walls

traits.zh: 庭院内有树木、地灯和支撑的树与灌木丛
traits.en: Courtyard with trees, ground lights, a supported tree, and shrubs

traits.zh: 店名‘白七’源于‘白＋七＝皂’，呼应制皂厂旧址
traits.en: Name 'White Seven' comes from 'white + seven = soap', referencing the former soap factory site
Coffee is the top recommended item on Gaode

linger.zh: 有庭院与照明，适合久坐
